annotations.title: Confirm or correct a statement (same as answer_question)

description: The earlier name of answer_question for a statement to check, kept for older clients: statement_id is the question id, verdict correct or wrong, and the right fact in corrected_text. Use this when a client still sends this name. Do not use for answers the person did not give. Side effects: changes the account's own Reputation Agent record.

corrected_text.description: With wrong: the right fact. Example: "Founded in 2018."

statement_id.description: The question id of a statement, from get_questions. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

name: confirm_statement
